name: sih-26171-js-tests
description: Node-native test runner (node:test) config for JS unit tests, e.g. Phase 3 (action-executor). Scoped to tests/ only -- does NOT touch extension/package.json, which is Phase 1's file and may be edited concurrently by other in-flight subagents. jsdom lives in tests/node_modules and resolves fine for test files under tests/unit/ via normal upward node_modules lookup.
